title: Sliding-Window Median Range Filter with std::multiset
hints: Keep the raw window in a `std::deque<double>` (FIFO order) and the same values in a `std::multiset<double>` (sorted order).
Evicting a value: `ms.erase(ms.find(v))` removes ONE copy. `ms.erase(v)` removes **every** copy, which is the classic multiset bug once ranges repeat.
Simple O(k) median: `std::next(ms.begin(), n / 2)`, plus its predecessor when n is even. That passes, but an interviewer will push for O(log k).

O(log k): two multisets. `lo` holds the smaller half, `hi` the larger, and `lo.size()` is `hi.size()` or `hi.size() + 1`. Median is `*lo.rbegin()` (odd) or the average with `*hi.begin()`. On erase, check which half holds the value, then rebalance.
